title: Qatar's first point, won at the death

slides.note: Two tournaments, three defeats, then the last kick. *Finally*.

slides.headline: Switzerland go ahead from the *spot*
slides.body: Sixteen minutes in, Qatar pick up a yellow. A minute later, Embolo steps up and sends the keeper the wrong way. Switzerland lead, and the favourites look set.

slides.headline: Muheim turns it into his *own* net
slides.body: Deep into stoppage time, a cross fizzes across the six-yard box. Miro Muheim stretches — and steers it past his own keeper. 90+4'. Qatar 1, Switzerland 1. A point from almost nothing.

slides.context: Saibari pounced on 21', Brahim Díaz the architect. Vinícius answered on 32'. Three years after Morocco first beat them, the favourites are *held* once more.
Irankunda lit the fuse on 27', Metcalfe doubled it on 75'. Turkey never found a way back. Australia start with a *clean* sheet and all three points.
McGinn's finish on 28' was the difference. Four yellows flew, none of them red — a scrap Scotland edged. *One* goal, three points.

slides.note: Up next: Germany v Curaçao, Netherlands v Japan & 2 more.
